answer: Each identity must operate a unique lantern that samples meadow microclimate every epoch and signs the reading inside a walnut-sized secure enclave; the proof is non-transferable. An attacker fielding 250 sybils must physically install and power 250 separate lanterns across real meadows, incurring about $10,000 hardware plus $600 daily logistics, while a single honest agent uses one device whose bond is refunded after clean epochs. Correlated sensor data across claimed identities triggers joint slash of all related bonds.
